rows.question: Hi! I have never been here before. What is DeskAtlas and how does it work?
rows.summary:
With DeskAtlas, you can book physical desks or rooms online or via an on-site kiosk. You can simply browse available spaces on the website, select your preferred date and time, and submit your contact details. This creates a pending request that does not hold inventory until you complete payment and receive official confirmation.

For website reservations, after submitting your request, you must pay using the official payment link provided in your confirmation email. You have 60 minutes to upload proof of payment. An administrator will then review your proof and allocate a specific workspace. Only after this final confirmation is your booking secured.

If you prefer to visit in person, you can use the shared on-site kiosk as a walk-in option. However, like the website, a kiosk queue number or payment transfer does not guarantee a specific desk until staff verify your request and assignment.

rows.question: I just need somewhere quiet to study and take an occasional video call. What would you recommend?
rows.summary:
For quiet study with occasional video calls, we recommend the Sky Den or Sky Booth. These are the only named rooms advertised as soundproof, making them suitable for spoken calls, unlike shared quiet desks where calls are prohibited.

Please note that while these rooms are advertised as soundproof, they do not guarantee absolute recording silence. You must verify the actual setup, current availability, and live pricing through the official booking interface or front desk before proceeding.

Current published capacities: Sky Booth: 1 person; Sky Den: 1 person.

rows.question: What if my plans change or I arrive late? Can I cancel, move the booking, or get a refund?
rows.summary:
To cancel or reschedule, you must request at least 24 hours before your start time; same-day changes are not accepted under the standard rule. If eligible, cancellations qualify for a 50% refund of the verified payment base, but clicking a control does not automatically process the return. For late arrivals, the booking end time does not shift, and no automatic credit is guaranteed.

To move your booking, you must request an authorized amendment with your reference and preferred new unit. Staff will check live availability and price differences; you must not occupy the new space until a revised confirmation is issued. Relocations are not automatic and require separate review.

For any disputes, retain your booking reference, original receipt, and official status. Contact the front desk or official SKYDY Messenger for resolution; do not share sensitive details in public chats.
